gull.name: the Gull
gull.description: A lean grey sloop of Tolmere pine with a single patched sail, built to be rowed out of a harbour by monks and sailed home by whoever is left.
gull.board_text: You step aboard the Gull. The deck lifts and settles under your boots as if it were breathing.
gull.disembark_text: You step down onto the quay.
gull.note: Lent by King Haldane after the duel. Crosses the grey sea; lost to the Maelrake.
